name: auto-coding
description: Risk-aware coding delivery for Codex: route by risk, plan proportionally, reuse before writing, verify with evidence, hand off safely.

interface.shortDescription: Risk-aware delivery: plan, implement, verify, hand off.
interface.longDescription: auto-coding is a risk-aware coding delivery skill for Codex. It routes every task to Fast, Standard, or High-risk execution by uncertainty and operational risk; plans only to the depth the route requires; enforces reuse over new code; verifies with the project's own toolchain under explicit PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_APPLICABLE evidence states; and requires authorization for spec initialization, installs, commits, deployments, and destructive operations.
defaultPrompt: Set up auto-coding for this repository.
Fix this bug with risk-aware routing and verification.
Implement this feature and verify it with the project's own tools.
